candidates.claim: firstLoad awaits readDefaultRange but reads state.defaultRange after it; when a newer onDidChange read is in flight, the awaited older read is discarded and firstLoad opens on the stale default while the setting says otherwise.
candidates.trigger: 1. Panel mounts; firstLoad registers onDidChange and calls readDefaultRange: read=1, awaits settings.get('defaultRange').  2. Before it answers, the user changes Default range in Orca settings to 30d; onDidChange fires; readDefaultRange: read=2 (defaultRangeReads=2), awaits.  3. Read 1 answers first (e.g. '1d' or the old value): read 1 !== defaultRangeReads 2, so state.defaultRange is not written.  4. readDefaultRange returns; firstLoad line 598 reads state.defaultRange = '7d' (initial value).  5. range 7d === state.range, moved=false; !report && !busy → load() with 7d.  6. Read 2 answers '30d': state.defaultRange = '30d' (read 2 is newest). Panel stays on 7d.
candidates.wrong: Opens on 7d though setting is 30d. state.defaultRange later becomes 30d, so a cleared custom range goes to 30d while the first view was 7d. Should: firstLoad waits for the newest read (or re-checks after the await) before choosing the opening range.
candidates.path: src/panel/panel.js:597 -> src/panel/panel.js:598 -> src/panel/panel.js:612-618 (readDefaultRange discard at :616) -> src/panel/panel.js:606

candidates.claim: The first report now waits on settings.get; while it is pending no load() runs, so no skeleton/status is shown and the first render is delayed by however long the host takes to answer or to time out.
candidates.trigger: 1. Panel opens; bindControls then firstLoad() runs. firstLoad registers onDidChange and awaits readDefaultRange (:597).  2. host.settings.get is slow or stuck (IPC busy).  3. load() is not called until the read settles; state.busy stays false, state.report stays null.  4. The skeleton (#skeleton, panel/index.html:508) and status are only toggled inside load() (:57-60), so nothing shows progress.  5. Read settles after the host's call deadline (plugin-panel-shell.js:115-119, code timeout) or on answer; only then request('usage.report').
candidates.wrong: Startup latency and no loading state tied to the wait. Baseline called load() at once (old bindControls ran load() directly). Should: start the first load immediately on the default and redo it on a changed setting, or show the skeleton before the read.
candidates.confidence: medium; depends on the skeleton's default visibility (panel/index.html:508, not read) and the deadline value for settings.get (C.deadlineMs / userMethodList, not read). Test 'the first report waits for the setting' (tests/panel.test.mjs:230-238) pins the waiting on purpose.
